hack.description: SushiSwap's 4-day-old RouteProcessor2 contract allowed anyone with a fake Uniswap V3 pool to drain tokens from any user who had approved it — costing $3.3M+ across 14 chains, and briefly rekt-ing DeFi villain 0xSifu for 1,800 ETH.
